name: Pradhan Mantri Kisan Samman Nidhi (PM-KISAN)
department: Ministry of Agriculture & Farmers Welfare
shortDescription: Direct income support of ₹6,000 per year paid in three equal installments to small and marginal farmer families across India.
fullDescription: Pradhan Mantri Kisan Samman Nidhi (PM-KISAN) is a Central Sector scheme with 100% funding from Government of India. Income support of 6,000/- per year in three equal installments is provided to all land-holding farmer families across the country.
applicationProcedure: Apply online at pmkisan.gov.in or through nearest Common Service Centre (CSC) with land records and Aadhaar.
benefits: ₹6,000 annual financial aid
Direct Benefit Transfer (DBT) into bank account
Zero middleman intervention
Coverage for landholding farmer families

additional_conditions: Must hold valid agricultural land ownership record (Khata/Khasra)

sources.notes: Verified operational guidelines and Direct Benefit Transfer portal.

name: Pradhan Mantri Awas Yojana - Urban (PMAY-U)
department: Ministry of Housing and Urban Affairs
shortDescription: Financial interest subsidy up to ₹2.67 Lakh for first-time urban home buyers and pucca house construction.
fullDescription: Pradhan Mantri Awas Yojana - Urban (PMAY-U) addresses urban housing shortage among EWS/LIG and MIG categories by ensuring a pucca house to all eligible urban households.
applicationProcedure: Apply online at pmaymis.gov.in or through empanelled primary lending institutions (PLIs).
benefits: Credit Linked Subsidy Scheme (CLSS) up to ₹2.67 Lakh
Direct financial grant for house construction
Mandatory female ownership co-applicant provision

additional_conditions: Must not own any pucca house anywhere in India in family name

sources.sourceAuthority: Ministry of Housing and Urban Affairs

name: Startup India Seed Fund Scheme (SISFS)
department: DPIIT, Ministry of Commerce and Industry
shortDescription: Financial assistance up to ₹50 Lakh for proof of concept, prototype development, product trials, and market entry.
fullDescription: Startup India Seed Fund Scheme (SISFS) provides financial assistance to early-stage startups for proof of concept, prototype development, product trials, market entry and commercialization.
applicationProcedure: Apply online at seedfund.startupindia.gov.in by selecting empanelled incubators.
benefits: Up to ₹20 Lakh grant for prototype validation
Up to ₹50 Lakh convertible debentures / debt investment
Incubator mentorship & network support

additional_conditions: Must possess valid DPIIT Startup Recognition Certificate
Business plan presentation for incubator validation

sources.sourceTitle: Startup India Seed Fund Official Portal
sources.sourceAuthority: DPIIT, Ministry of Commerce and Industry

name: Pradhan Mantri Vidyalaxmi Scheme
department: Department of Higher Education, Ministry of Education
shortDescription: Collateral-free, guarantor-free education loan up to ₹10 Lakh with 7.5% interest subvention for meritorious students.
fullDescription: Pradhan Mantri Vidyalaxmi is a Central Sector Scheme providing financial support to meritorious students pursuing higher education in top 860 quality Higher Educational Institutions (HEIs) across India.
applicationProcedure: Apply online at vidyalakshmi.co.in or pmvidyalaxmi.education.gov.in.
benefits: 100% collateral-free and guarantor-free loan
7.5% interest subvention for annual family income up to ₹8 Lakh
Covers tuition fees, hostel, books and equipment

additional_conditions: Must hold proof of admission in recognized Higher Education Institution (HEI)

name: Pradhan Mantri Matru Vandana Yojana (PMMVY)
department: Ministry of Women and Child Development
shortDescription: Maternity benefit of ₹6,000 provided directly to pregnant women and lactating mothers for first and second child.
fullDescription: Pradhan Mantri Matru Vandana Yojana (PMMVY) is a Direct Benefit Transfer (DBT) maternity scheme under which cash incentive of ₹5,000 is provided directly to pregnant women and lactating mothers.
applicationProcedure: Register at nearest Anganwadi Centre or apply online via pmmvy.wcd.gov.in.
benefits: ₹5,000 in installments + ₹1,000 institutional delivery incentive
Direct Benefit Transfer into Aadhaar-seeded bank account
Nutritional support during pregnancy

additional_conditions: Mother & Child Protection (MCP) Card registration required

sources.sourceTitle: PMMVY Ministry of Women and Child Development
sources.sourceAuthority: Ministry of Women and Child Development

name: PM Street Vendor's AtmaNirbhar Nidhi (PM SVANidhi)
department: Ministry of Housing and Urban Affairs
shortDescription: Collateral-free working capital loan up to ₹50,000 with 7% interest subsidy for street vendors.
fullDescription: PM SVANidhi is a special micro-credit facility providing affordable working capital loans of ₹10,000, ₹20,000 and ₹50,000 to street vendors to resume livelihoods impacted by lockdowns.
applicationProcedure: Apply online at pmsvanidhi.mohua.gov.in or through nearest Common Service Centre (CSC).
benefits: Initial ₹10,000 loan with enhanced limit on timely repayment
7% interest subsidy credited directly to bank account
Cashback up to ₹1,200/year on digital transactions
documentsRequired: Certificate of Vending (CoV) / Letter of Recommendation

additional_conditions: Certificate of Vending or Urban Local Body (ULB) recommendation letter

sources.sourceAuthority: Ministry of Housing and Urban Affairs

name: Ayushman Bharat - Pradhan Mantri Jan Arogya Yojana (PM-JAY)
department: National Health Authority
shortDescription: Health coverage of ₹5 Lakh per family per year for secondary and tertiary care hospitalization across empanelled hospitals.
fullDescription: Ayushman Bharat PM-JAY is the world's largest health assurance scheme providing health cover of Rs 5 Lakhs per family per year for secondary and tertiary care hospitalization to over 12 crore poor families.
applicationProcedure: Check eligibility online at beneficiary.nha.gov.in and generate Ayushman Card at empanelled hospital.
benefits: ₹5 Lakh free cashless health cover per family per year
Cashless treatment at empanelled public & private hospitals
Covers pre and post-hospitalization medical expenses

additional_conditions: SECC 2011 data verification or active Ration Card

name: Mahatma Gandhi National Rural Employment Guarantee Act (MGNREGA)
department: Ministry of Rural Development
shortDescription: Guarantees 100 days of wage employment per financial year to at least one adult member of every rural household.
fullDescription: MGNREGA aims to enhance livelihood security in rural areas by providing at least 100 days of guaranteed wage employment in a financial year to adult members willing to do unskilled manual work.
applicationProcedure: Submit application for Job Card at local Gram Panchayat office.
benefits: 100 days guaranteed wage employment per year
Equal wages for men and women
Unemployment allowance if work is not provided within 15 days

additional_conditions: Gram Panchayat Job Card registration

name: Pradhan Mantri Kisan Urja Suraksha evam Utthaan Mahabhiyan (PM-KUSUM)
department: Ministry of New and Renewable Energy
shortDescription: Up to 60% subsidy for solar water pump installation and grid-connected solar power plant setup on agricultural land.
fullDescription: PM-KUSUM scheme aims to provide energy security to farmers in India along with de-dieselization of the farm sector by installing standalone solar pumps and solarizing existing grid-connected pumps.
applicationProcedure: Apply online at pmkusum.mnre.gov.in or through state nodal renewable energy agencies.
benefits: 60% combined subsidy (Central 30% + State 30%) for solar pumps
Additional income by selling surplus solar power back to DISCOMs
Uninterrupted daytime solar power for irrigation

additional_conditions: Agricultural land ownership or water source availability for solar pump installation

sources.sourceAuthority: Ministry of New and Renewable Energy

name: Chief Minister Abhyudaya Yojana
department: Department of Social Welfare, Uttar Pradesh
shortDescription: Free competitive exam coaching (UPSC, UPPSC, NEET, JEE) along with free tablets for meritorious youth in Uttar Pradesh.
fullDescription: CM Abhyudaya Scheme provides free physical and online coaching by IAS, IPS, and expert officers to aspirants preparing for competitive examinations.
applicationProcedure: Register online at abhyuday.up.gov.in and appear for entrance assessment.
benefits: Free physical & virtual classes by IAS/IPS officers
Free tablet distribution for top rankers in selection test
Comprehensive digital study material and test series

additional_conditions: Uttar Pradesh domicile certificate required

name: Kalaignar Magalir Urimai Thittam
department: Special Programme Implementation Dept, Tamil Nadu
shortDescription: Monthly financial grant of ₹1,000 directly credited to eligible female heads of families in Tamil Nadu.
fullDescription: A flagship scheme recognizing the uncompensated labor of women, granting ₹1,000 monthly to over 1.15 crore eligible women in Tamil Nadu.
applicationProcedure: Apply at special camps organized across Tamil Nadu public distribution outlets.
benefits: ₹1,000 monthly rights grant credited on 15th of every month
Direct Benefit Transfer into bank account
Special grievance redressal camps

additional_conditions: Tamil Nadu Smart Ration Card proof required

name: Mukhyamantri Kisan Sahay Yojana
department: Agriculture Dept, Govt of Gujarat
shortDescription: Crop loss compensation up to ₹25,000 per hectare without requiring premium payment from farmers.
fullDescription: Replaces traditional crop insurance to provide zero-cost compensation for drought, unseasonal rainfall, and flood crop damages in Gujarat.
applicationProcedure: Apply through iKhedut portal (ikhedut.gujarat.gov.in).
benefits: ₹25,000/ha (>60% crop loss)
Zero premium requirement from farmers

additional_conditions: Gujarat land record proof required

name: Delhi Ladli Scheme
department: Department of Women and Child Development, Delhi
shortDescription: Financial deposit up to ₹11,000 created in the name of the girl child at milestones from birth to Class 12.
fullDescription: Delhi Ladli Scheme aims to promote empowerment of girl children, enhance institutional deliveries, and eliminate school dropout rates by depositing financial assistance at various stages.
applicationProcedure: Submit application through government/recognized school or nearest WCD department office.
benefits: ₹11,000 for institutional birth
₹5,000 staged deposits at Class 1, 6, 9, 10 & 12 admission
Maturity amount with interest payable upon reaching 18 years

additional_conditions: Must be born in Delhi and resident of Delhi for at least 3 years

name: UP Mukhyamantri Kanya Sumangala Yojana
department: Women & Child Development Department, UP
shortDescription: Staged financial grant up to ₹25,000 transferred directly to girl children from birth to higher education.
fullDescription: Mukhyamantri Kanya Sumangala Yojana provides conditional cash transfer of ₹25,000 in six categories to ensure health, education, and protection for girl children in Uttar Pradesh.
applicationProcedure: Apply online at mksy.up.gov.in.
benefits: ₹5,000 on birth & ₹2,000 on complete vaccination
₹7,000 upon admission into Degree / Diploma course

additional_conditions: Uttar Pradesh domicile certificate required
Maximum 2 girl children per family

name: Pradhan Mantri Jan Dhan Yojana (PMJDY)
department: Department of Financial Services, Ministry of Finance
shortDescription: Zero-balance savings account with ₹2 Lakh accidental insurance and ₹10,000 overdraft facility.
fullDescription: Pradhan Mantri Jan Dhan Yojana is National Mission for Financial Inclusion to ensure access to financial services, namely, Basic Savings Bank Deposit Accounts, remittance, credit, insurance, pension.
applicationProcedure: Visit any bank branch or Bank Mitra kiosk with Aadhaar card.
benefits: Zero minimum balance requirement
Free RuPay Debit Card with ₹2 Lakh accidental insurance
₹10,000 overdraft facility after 6 months of satisfactory operation

name: Pradhan Mantri Mudra Yojana (PMMY)
department: Ministry of Finance
shortDescription: Collateral-free business loans up to ₹20 Lakh under Shishu, Kishore, and Tarun categories.
fullDescription: Pradhan Mantri MUDRA Yojana (PMMY) provides loans up to ₹20 Lakh to non-corporate, non-farm small/micro enterprises for income generating activities.
applicationProcedure: Apply online via UdyamiMitra portal (udyamimitra.in) or visit any commercial bank.
benefits: Shishu (Up to ₹50,000), Kishore (₹50k to ₹5 Lakh), Tarun (₹5L to ₹20 Lakh)
Zero collateral or third-party guarantor requirement
MUDRA Card for flexible working capital withdrawal

additional_conditions: Non-farm small business or enterprise plan required

name: PM Vishwakarma Scheme
department: Ministry of Micro, Small & Medium Enterprises (MSME)
shortDescription: Collateral-free credit up to ₹3 Lakh at 5% interest, toolkits, and skill training for 18 traditional artisan trades.
fullDescription: PM Vishwakarma is a Central Sector Scheme to provide end-to-end support to artisans and craftspeople engaged in 18 traditional trades like carpenters, blacksmiths, goldsmiths, and potters.
applicationProcedure: Register at CSC centres via pmvishwakarma.gov.in.
benefits: PM Vishwakarma Certificate and ID Card
₹15,000 e-voucher for modern toolkits
Collateral-free credit support of ₹1 Lakh (Tranche 1) and ₹2 Lakh (Tranche 2) at 5% interest

additional_conditions: Must be working with hands and tools in one of 18 family-based traditional trades

name: Sukanya Samriddhi Yojana (SSY)
department: Ministry of Finance / India Post
shortDescription: High-interest tax-free small savings scheme for girl children below 10 years with 8.2% annual interest.
fullDescription: Sukanya Samriddhi Account is a government-backed small savings scheme designed for the financial security and higher education of girl children across India.
applicationProcedure: Open account at any Post Office or authorized commercial bank branch.
benefits: Highest interest rate among small savings schemes (8.2%)
Triple Tax Exemption under Section 80C (EEE status)
Partial withdrawal allowed for higher education after age 18

additional_conditions: Girl child must be below 10 years of age at account opening

name: Atal Pension Yojana (APY)
department: PFRDA, Ministry of Finance
shortDescription: Guaranteed monthly pension between ₹1,000 to ₹5,000 from age 60 for unorganized sector workers.
fullDescription: Atal Pension Yojana (APY) is a government-backed pension scheme targeted at unorganized sector workers providing guaranteed minimum monthly pension after 60 years of age.
applicationProcedure: Subscribe through bank branch or netbanking portal.
benefits: Guaranteed monthly pension of ₹1k, ₹2k, ₹3k, ₹4k, or ₹5k
Same pension to spouse upon subscriber's death
Return of total accumulated corpus to nominee

additional_conditions: Must not be an income taxpayer

name: Pradhan Mantri Jeevan Jyoti Bima Yojana (PMJJBY)
department: Ministry of Finance
shortDescription: Life insurance cover of ₹2 Lakh for any cause of death at a nominal premium of ₹436 per annum.
fullDescription: Pradhan Mantri Jeevan Jyoti Bima Yojana is a one-year renewable life insurance scheme offering ₹2 Lakh coverage for death due to any reason.
applicationProcedure: Submit auto-debit consent form at bank branch or via mobile banking.
benefits: ₹2,00,000 death benefit payable to nominee
Low annual premium of ₹436 auto-debited once a year
Simple enrollment without medical checkup

additional_conditions: Must give auto-debit consent on bank savings account

name: Subhadra Yojana
department: Women & Child Development Dept, Odisha
shortDescription: Financial assistance of ₹10,000 per year paid in two installments of ₹5,000 each on Rakhi Purnima & Women's Day.
fullDescription: Subhadra Yojana is Odisha's landmark financial assistance scheme for women, empowering over 1 crore women with ₹50,000 total grant over 5 years.
applicationProcedure: Submit printed form at Mo Seba Kendra or apply online via subhadra.odisha.gov.in.
benefits: ₹10,000 annual direct transfer in two installments
Subhadra Debit Card with incentives for digital transactions
Coverage for over 1 crore women in Odisha

additional_conditions: Odisha domicile and NFSA/SFSS ration card coverage required

name: Gruha Lakshmi Scheme
department: Women and Child Development Dept, Karnataka
shortDescription: Monthly assistance of ₹2,000 transferred to female heads of families holding BPL/APL cards in Karnataka.
fullDescription: Gruha Lakshmi Scheme provides ₹2,000 monthly financial aid directly to the bank accounts of female heads of households across Karnataka.
applicationProcedure: Apply at Grama One, Karnataka One or Bangalore One centers.
benefits: ₹2,000 monthly direct bank transfer
Coverage for BPL, Antyodaya, and APL cardholder families
Direct Benefit Transfer into Aadhaar linked account

additional_conditions: Karnataka Ration Card & female head of household designation required
